author: Badgeslol
notes: Credit, and a start and finish read from the map's own logic (gb-maps-2). 20 team spawns stand in a 512-square room whose trigger plays the opening (screen overlays and a heartbeat); that trigger is the start. The finish is the small trigger that fades out, sets off the confetti and its sound. Between them are checkpoint sections cp1..cp8 (the map renames a player `cpN` and its pits behind each name send to that section's start; they stay pits here, as bhop_pandora2_fix's do) and boost pads (bact/boost names). Its blocks are once-only: each renames the player xhop1..xhop6 in turn, and a teleport on every block behind filter_multi bh12..bh16 (two neighbouring names) sends a player who lands on the same block twice back; those are dropped as conditional, so a block can be touched twice here. Not published.
